name: v07-holdout-photo
description: SS11.12 - the round-3 holdout validation of every tune-chosen change on the photographic split, run after all tune decisions were settled. It is not the split's first consultation: the same 32 images had already validated rounds 1 and 2 (SS4.5, SS7.12, SS10.3), and SS11.12 records that history. Consulting holdout per-experiment would make it a second tune set. The incumbent is the constants as shipped at the start of SS11, so the deltas are what stabilizing v0.7 actually moved the format by.
